lesson.name: Learn the Closed Sicilian
lesson.description: Watch a video to learn the strengths and weaknesses of the Closed Sicilian, a slow-building opening, with many tactical opportunities hiding under the surface.

{White can continue with a Closed Sicilian with 3.g3, but it could also make
sense to trick your opponent into playing the Accelerated Dragon Variation of
the Open Sicilian. How can you transpose to that variation?} 3. Nf3 {[%wrong
There's a better move. Try to find a way to develop and prepare d2-d4.] [%hint
Defend d4 and develop a knight.]} (3. Bc4 $5 {This is an OK move, but doesn't
aim for an Open Sicilian. How can you transpose into one of those variations?})
(3. Nge2 $5 {This is reasonable, but there's a more active square for the
knight. Try to find it.}) (3. g3 $5 {This is an OK move, but doesn't aim for
an Open Sicilian. How can you transpose into one of those variations?}) (3. f4
$5 {This is an OK move, but doesn't aim for an Open Sicilian. How can you
transpose into one of those variations?}) (3. d4 $5 {This is a good move, but
doesn't allow you to recapture on d4 with a knight. How should you develop and
prepare to get a knight to d4?}) 3... Bg7 {Good start! How can you reach an
Open Sicilian?} 4. d4 {[%wrong There's a stronger move. Try to find a central
pawn break.] [%hint Place a 2nd pawn in the center.] Great work! After cxd4,
the game reaches the Hyper-Accelerated Dragon Variation, which is one that
Black might not be familiar with.} (4. Bc4 $5 {This is a good move, but strong
players most frequently transpose to an open Sicilian. How can you do that?}) *

{White has prepared d4 to reach an Open Sicilian. How can Black prevent that
plan?} 3... e5 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find a way to further
control d4.] [%hint Control d4 with another pawn.] Well played! Black prevents
d4 with a solid position.} (3... d6 $5 {This is OK, but doesn't prevent White
from playing d4. How can you avoid an Open Sicilian?}) (3... e6 $5 {This is OK,
but doesn't prevent White from playing d4. How can you avoid an Open Sicilian?}
) (3... Nf6 $5 {This is OK, but doesn't prevent White from playing d4. How can
you avoid an Open Sicilian?}) (3... g6 $5 {This is OK, but doesn't prevent
White from playing d4. How can you avoid an Open Sicilian?}) (3... Qb6 $2 4.
Bb5 {Black's queen is poorly placed on b6. Try to find a better way to control
the d4 square.}) (3... Nd4 $2 4. Bc4 {White is slightly better. Try to find a
stronger move to control d4.}) *

{How should White open the center to take advantage of the lead in development?
} 4. exd5 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find a good capture.] [%hint
Trade pawns to open the center.]} (4. d4 $5 {This is reasonable, but we
suggest trading pawns before playing d4. How can you do that?}) (4. e5 $2 d4 {
Black has a space advantage. Try to find a better pawn move.}) (4. d3 $2 d4 {
Black has a space advantage. Try to find a better pawn move.}) 4... exd5 {
Nice start! How can you challenge Black's pawn center?} 5. d4 {[%wrong There's
a better move. Try to find a strong pawn advance.] [%hint Place a pawn in the
center.] Well done! White has good center control and a lead in development.} (
5. Nf4 $2 Nf6 {Black has a comfortable position. Try to find a good pawn move
instead.}) (5. d3 $2 d4 {Black has a comfortable position. Try to find a
better square for your d-pawn.}) *

{Black has fallen into a trap and White can win material. How?} 10. Bd2 {
[%wrong Illegal] [%hint Block the check with a threat.]} (10. Qd2 $2 Qxd2+ {
White is doing well, but there's a much stronger move. Try to find it.}) (10.
c3 $2 Bxc3+ {Black is doing well. Try to find a better move.}) (10. Kf1 $2 Bg7
{Black is doing well. Try to find a better move.}) (10. Nc3 $2 Bxc3+ {Black is
winning. Try again.}) 10... Qxa2 {Good move! How can you win material?} 11.
Rxb2 {[%wrong There's a stronger move. Try to find a good sacrifice.] [%hint
Sacrifice an exchange to lure Black's queen to the long diagonal.]} (11. c3 $5
{White is doing well, but there's a more forcing move to win material. Try to
find it.}) (11. Bc3 $2 Bxc3+ {Black has good counterplay. Try to find a
stronger move.}) (11. Nc3 $5 {White is doing well, but there's a stronger move.
Try to find it.}) 11... Qxb2 {Great work! How should you win material?} 12. Bc3
{[%wrong Black is doing well. Try to find a winning fork.] [%hint Fork the
black queen and a rook.]} Qb6 {Great job! What's next?} 13. Bxh8 {[%wrong
There's a better option. Try to find a winning capture.] [%hint Capture a rook.
] Well done!} *

is doing well, but there's an even better pawn move. Try to find it.}) (9...

{How should Black prepare to evict the white queen from h5?} 10... f6 {[%wrong

[%hint Open the h5-e8 diagonal.]} (10... fxe4 $2 11. Ng5 {White has a winning attack.
Try to find a stronger move and check the hint if you're stuck.}) (10... Nd4 $2
11. exf5 {White has a dangerous attack. Try to find a stronger move and check
the hint if you're stuck.}) (10... d5 $2 11. exf5 {White has a dangerous

a good queen trade.] [%hint Offer to trade queens.] Good decision! White must

position.} *

{How should White prepare a kingside pawn storm?} 9. h3 {[%wrong There's a
better option. Try to find a pawn move to control g4.] [%hint Defend g4 with a
pawn.]} (9. f5 $2 gxf5 {Black is doing well. Try to find a stronger pawn move.}
) (9. g4 $2 Nxg4 {Black is doing well. Try to find a stronger pawn move.}) (9.
Be3 $2 b6 {Black is doing well. Try to find a strong pawn move to prevent
Black from playing Ng4.}) (9. h4 $2 Bg4 {Black is doing well. Try to find a
stronger pawn move.}) 9... b5 {Good start! How should you continue your
kingside pawn expansion?} 10. g4 {[%wrong There's a better option. Try to find
a good pawn advance on the kingside.] [%hint Defend f5 with another pawn.]} (
10. a3 $5 {Black is doing well. Try to find a stronger pawn move.}) (10. Kh2 $5
{Black is doing well. Try to find a strong pawn move.}) (10. Ne2 $5 {Black is
doing well. Try to find a strong pawn move.}) (10. Rf2 $5 {Black is doing well.

find a stronger pawn move.}) 10... b4 {Well played! How should you save your
knight?} 11. Ne2 {[%wrong Black wins material. Try to find a good knight move.]
[%hint Retreat your knight to the kingside.]} (11. Nb1 $2 Nd7 {Black is doing
well. Try to find a stronger knight move.}) (11. Na4 $2 Qa5 {Black is doing
well. Try to find a stronger knight move.}) (11. Nd5 $2 Nxd5 {Black is doing

White continue to take more space on the kingside?} 12. f5 {[%wrong There's a
better move. Try to find a good pawn push.] [%hint Restrict the c8-bishop with
a pawn advance.] Well played! White has an initiative on the kingside,
although the game Amin - Can 2017 was eventually drawn.} (12. g5 $2 Nh5 {

OK, but GM Amin preferred to expand on the kingside. How did he do it?}) *
